title: Remove the stride-window tracking term from the experimental yaw-gated reward
summary: locomotion.task_v4_yaw_gate returns to the threshold, bonus and floor version; stride_tracking_weight and stride_window_controls are removed. On the surrogate, seed 20260917, with 30 percent turn draws, a 120-control gate window, a 0.18 rad/s threshold, bonus 0.25 and floor 0.5: stride weight 0.3 passed 11 of 13 learning probes at 5000 updates against 8 of 13 without the term, walked at a median 0.85 of the commanded speed against 0.70, and turned at 0.196 and -0.168 rad/s, but its heading drifted 36 to 51 degrees on three translation probes that the rate-based yaw check passes, against at most 18 degrees without the term. Stride weight 1 with termination weight 30 fell 957 times in the last 1500 updates and passed none. One seed; native runs remain the acceptance evidence.
next: Run a second surrogate seed of turn-heavy sampling with and without the bonus-and-floor gate, report total heading drift beside the probe verdicts, then propose one configuration for a native 5000-update run.
reason: Removing an opt-in option of an experimental task changes no native result, gate or default reward.
